result.summary: WF-02 step 4, REVIEWER, on the change of step 02 (tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js, tools/test/fixtures/e2e-stand/fake-stand.js, tools/README.md; git diff against base/E2E106-20261115-01: 205, 66 and 15 lines, nothing else in tools/). Verdict PASS: no Critical, High or Medium finding; five Low findings (L1-L5) and four Low remarks for the tests of step 5 (T1-T4), none blocking. (1) The cause is fixed, not hidden: a folder now reaches a stand only as the value that rule P returned (the checked objects are the only ones the spawn uses), the private home is made in the same call as the spawn and set last, and a write through the home lookup is read in stop() before the home goes. Measured with the real Pixel Office through the changed starter (trial t2): with stateEnv the link answers 200, the home stays empty, stop() gives code 0; with no state folder Pixel Office falls back to its home lookup, which is now the private home, and stop() fails with 'STAND_HOME_WRITTEN: office wrote into its own home folder: .sai-pixel-office' - so the net of C-4 works on the real server, not only on the stand-in. No error is swallowed: a home that cannot be read becomes the entry '(not readable: ENOENT)' (t3), a home that cannot be made is STAND_START_FAILED with the marker removed and 0 spawns (t3), CLEANUP_FAILED wins over STAND_HOME_WRITTEN (t4). (2) Agreement with the design and decisions/0112: the options, the members (stateEnv frozen, homeDir, no stateDirs; the Stand frozen), every USAGE message of 4.1 word for word (trial t1, 50 cases: 18 USAGE, 25 PATH_REFUSED, 7 that reach the recording spawn), the order (all USAGE first, then rule P on stateEnv, env, args, then the marker, the home, the spawn - t1 order cases), the precedence CLEANUP_FAILED > STAND_HOME_WRITTEN > STAND_STOP_TIMEOUT > STAND_EXIT (read, t4, mutant M11), the three new stand-in modes and its guard (15 modes), the README texts of section 10 (the sentence, the paragraph, the table and the line each found once in the section, the paragraph equal as a whole), Node 22, ES modules, built-ins only (0002), cleanup.js, guards.js and src unchanged (0112 О13, О14: an env value inside the repository is refused). The builder's departures: I4 (the 'inside the repository' message names the real path) is what the prototype that passed gate 1b does, a Low text difference from design 4.1 (L3); I5 (the script exemption recognised by the reason text of guards.js) is a text coupling, fail-closed and loud (mutant M05 turns E2S-01, E2S-03, E2S-22 red), Low (L1); I6 (only the part after the first '=') is the design's own limit; trial t1 shows a=b=<path>, -d<path> and rel:<path> reach the spawn unchecked, and Pixel Office takes its folder only as --dir <v> or --dir=<v> (src/pixel-office/main.js:39-52) and refuses a relative one, so no Pixel Office path is opened by them. (3) Nothing beyond the order: the three files of the write set only; the small refactor namedBase()/BASE_NAMES serves the stateEnv check; the stand-in's stderr line on a failed write is a fixture detail (I7). (4) The bar holds: no skip, todo, disabled rule, hidden exit code or secret in the changed files (the search is in self_check); the three red tests are exactly the EXPECTED_RED of the design. (5) Idioms: as the neighbouring kit code (E2eError codes, safeText on child-controlled text, sync fs in the start path as before); the shared rule P is one function used in the three places (AP-014). Runs: kit files 72 / 69 / 3 (E2S-01, E2S-03, E2S-05); npm test once 2207 / 2204 / 3 (the same three); lint and format:check clean; npm run -s e2e -- picker exit 0, 9 of 9, duration_ms 17501; the designer's step-01c starter tests (the model of step 5) on the change 22 of 22; 25 mutants, 22 red in the expected tests, 3 survivors (M16, M20, M22) that are gaps of the planned tests, not of the code. The five real files are unchanged before and after. findings.place: tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js:77-79 (isPlainObject) used at 141 for stateEnv (and at 127 for env, released)
findings.what: Design 4.1 [F10]: 'Not a plain object -> USAGE startStand: stateEnv must be an object'. isPlainObject accepts any object that is not a list, so stateEnv: new Map([['SAI_X', <folder>]]) is taken as {} without a word and the server gets no state variable (trial t1, case 'stateEnv Map with a folder': the spawn was reached with HOME and USERPROFILE only). issues.text: Facts of the task checked: the diff of the three files against the tag (only these three in tools/), the expected counts (kit files 72 / 69 / 3 with exactly E2S-01, E2S-03, E2S-05; npm test 2207 / 2204 / 3) - both held. The task names no expected verdict (AP-018 not touched).

For ORCH (quality-bar §6, item 6; finding L2): the starter takes a non-plain object (a Map, a class instance) as stateEnv or env and gives the server nothing from it, while design 4.1 [F10] says such a value is USAGE. Not blocking: the home net catches the Pixel Office fallback (t2 b). Proposal: a defect or a one-line change by CODE-FIXER if ORCH wants it in this run, with a row in E2S-02.

ISS-0110, one more caller confirmed by a run (design section 20): an entry name of the home folder with U+202E reaches the STAND_HOME_WRITTEN message unescaped (trial t3, case 2); \u0007 is escaped. DOC-UPDATER adds the caller, as the design says; not fixed here.

For the design of REQ-107: rule P treats any env value that starts with an absolute path as one path, so a list of folders (PATH, NODE_PATH) given in env is refused as outside the temporary root (fail-closed). A spec cannot override PATH with absolute folders through env; the base PATH of the spec process is passed as before.

The copies of this step were made with git clone -b base/E2E106-20261115-01 from the local repository (docs/workflows/handoffs.md, common rule 3, which says a copy is a fresh clone and not git archive, AP-074, AP-146), while the lesson of AP-136 item (1) says no git clone that checks out a tree and git archive instead. The two texts disagree; I followed the protocol. No checkout, reset, stash or clean was run anywhere. ORCH may settle the wording.

What I used of other steps, read only: the gate's tripwire (<scratch>/e2e106-01b/guard/tripwire.cjs, loaded with my own logs) and the designer's step-01c test files (<scratch>/e2e106-01/proto/tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js and e2e-kit.test.js, copied into my own copy as the model of the step-5 tests; their mutant verdicts are predictions for TEST-DESIGNER, not the final tests). fake-stand.js was never imported: it ran only as a child started by the starter or by the model tests. SECURITY-REVIEWER ran at the same time; I did not coordinate with it; while my npm test and the picker spec ran, ps showed no other test or browser run.

Anti-pattern candidates for DOC-UPDATER (Q13, if ORCH agrees): (1) an exemption decided by matching the reason text of another module's error is a silent coupling - here fail-closed and pinned, but the shape repeats (L1); (2) a check 'is a plain object' that only rejects lists lets a Map through as empty (L2).
